biography:
Process driven real estate professional in the real estate industry who continuously strives to bring order to the chaotic transaction process through expertise in procedure implementation, site selection, financial analysis, risk mitigation, and transaction execution.  Strong written and verbal communication skills and valuable team member who fosters best practices and thrives in fast-paced demanding environments.

An avid guitar player and ukulele enthusiast who is working on the harmonica to satiate his thirst for musical exploration and creativity.  I enjoy outdoor activities including camping, hiking, skiing, snowboarding, and am on a never ending quest to find the perfect adventure van, a 1969 Volkswagen Kombi Bus to park on a 40+ acre lot that I will one day self develop.
